name: Variable Video Production — India
description: Turn one master brand film into thousands of localized video versions — per store, per offer, per Indian language — rendered from your data.

mainEntity.name: How many language versions can Flipick create from a single master video?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flipick renders a version per language from a single master — Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi and more. Each region's offer, rate and local details are built into that language's version automatically, without separate shoots for each language.

mainEntity.name: Is VVP affordable for mid-size businesses with hundreds of dealer outlets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Because variants are rendered from your data rather than re-shot, per-variant cost collapses toward zero at scale. Your 500th version costs about the same as your first, making a localized video per dealer or outlet practical for the first time.

mainEntity.name: How does VVP work for festive and seasonal campaigns in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: You produce one seasonal master film and Flipick renders a version per store, zone or language — with that location's offer and rate built in. When offers change, only the data feed needs updating; the master film stays the same.

mainEntity.name: Which channels can Flipick VVP videos be delivered through in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: VVP videos can be delivered through WhatsApp, YouTube, Meta, retail media networks, and in-store screens. Every variant is tracked per recipient, and you keep the data throughout.
